name: SDLC
description: Engineering practice run with the human rather than recited at them. The agile loop takes a change to an existing system from a one-sentence outcome through slices, a user-written acceptance criterion, a proposed test table, failing tests, generated code and a three-pass review. Around it: orient, spike, greenfield, pair-programming, harness and adr. The user, not the model, makes every judgment call.
